meaning_en: {path} is not a file; a workbook map is tables.tsv and columns.tsv in one folder
meaning_zh: {path} 不是文件；工作簿映射是同一文件夹里的 tables.tsv 和 columns.tsv
{file} 第 {line} 行：{column} 的值 {value} 不是 {expected}

meaning_en: columns.tsv line {line}: table {table_id} is not in tables.tsv
meaning_zh: columns.tsv 第 {line} 行：表 {table_id} 不在 tables.tsv 里

meaning_en: columns.tsv line {line}: {header} goes out, so it needs its owning harness
meaning_zh: columns.tsv 第 {line} 行：{header} 要写回工作簿，必须写明归属的 harness

meaning_en: {sheet} / {header}: written by more than one row ({owners}); an outgoing column has one owner
meaning_zh: {sheet} / {header}：有多行要写这一列（{owners}）；写回的列只能有一个归属

meaning_en: columns.tsv line {line}: field {field} is not in the harness's field vocabulary
meaning_zh: columns.tsv 第 {line} 行：字段 {field} 不在 harness 的字段表里

meaning_en: columns.tsv line {line}: a field with no place in the workbook ({field}) needs header - and a note that says why
meaning_zh: columns.tsv 第 {line} 行：在工作簿里没有位置的字段（{field}）要写 header 为 - 并在 note 里说明原因

meaning_en: tables.tsv: {table_id} names {header} (key or market) but columns.tsv has no row for it
meaning_zh: tables.tsv：{table_id} 用到 {header}（键或市场），但 columns.tsv 没有这一列

meaning_en: the workbook map has {count} problem(s); nothing was read through it
meaning_zh: 工作簿映射有 {count} 个问题；没有按它读取任何内容
